content.short: Open-source frontend layout for the Ethereum Transaction Viewer project, built with TypeScript.
content.description: This repository provides the frontend layout used by the Ethereum Transaction Viewer project. It was built by @samczsun using TypeScript and is offered as a free-to-use resource. The code serves as a practical starting point for developers looking to create a similar scanner and customize it for multichain use, as hinted by the multichain dropdown in the home search box, inviting extension to additional networks without modifying the core architecture.
content.meta: Ethereum Transaction Viewer is a frontend for Ethereum transactions. Discover Ethereum Transaction Viewer and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
